name: Hue Festival
summary: Festival Huế 2026 is a year-long chain, opened at Ngọ Môn on 1 January 2026, with an arts week from 13 to 18 June. It is not the ordinary citadel ticket. A visitor fee is check on arrival, and dates after 2026 are check on arrival.
when: 1 January 2026 through 31 December 2026. Arts week 13–18 June 2026. Later years: check on arrival.
